wizard.title: Getting started
wizard.page1: mux.social brings the open social web into one place. It aggregates posts from Hashiverse, Nostr, Mastodon, and Bluesky — no account or server required. Everything runs in your browser; nothing is stored anywhere else.
wizard.page2: You organise posts into timelines — independent columns you can name. Create as many as you like; each merges its own set of sources, newest first. Scroll a timeline vertically for more posts, and sideways to move between timelines.
wizard.page3: Fill a timeline by adding addresses — a Bluesky handle, a Nostr npub, a Mastodon @user@server, or a Hashiverse id. Click the timeline's + button to add one (or the paste button to add from your clipboard). Their posts merge into that timeline, newest first.
wizard.page4: That's it! Add your first timeline with the pulsing "Add timeline" button at the top right, then use the pulsing + button on that timeline to add an address.

config.title: Config
config.description: The box below contains your settings as JSON: your timelines and your GUI settings (theme, language). To move them to another machine, copy this text and paste it into this same dialog there, then press Apply. Apply validates the text and replaces this browser's settings with it; Revert restores the box to the current settings.
